Voat already has most of the obvious RES features built in, but one big one that I'd like to see is an account switcher. A lot of people have multiple accounts for various reasons, and I think if nothing else most of us have one regular account and a porn alt, so that we don't wind up going to check, say, /r/news in public and wind up seeing results from /r/simps (in case context was not enough there: NSFW). An account switcher makes the whole process a lot more pleasant and less likely to turn into a TIFU post. If there's worries about people using alts to get around the 10 sub moderation limit, I could see having a limited number of accounts in the default switcher, maybe even just the two. Or maybe even a toggle so everything is on one account, but you can filter which subverses you see at any given time with the press of a button, e.g., all your porn subs on one button, gaming on another, embarrassing fandom stuff on a third, whatever.
